description:
Player profile, Rust stats and achievements. Profile summary (name, avatar, country, Steam level, account age), VAC/game bans, Rust playtime, every Rust
stat Steam exposes grouped into Combat / Animals & NPCs / How you died / Gathering & loot / Building / Travel /
Life on the island / Fishing / Music / Everything else, six headline figures (kills, deaths, K/D, headshots,
bullet and arrow accuracy), and all 116 achievements with unlock dates. `stats_private` is true when the
profile hides game details, in which case `groups` and `achievements` are empty.

steamid.description: 17-digit SteamID64. Use /players/resolve for URLs and vanity names.

name: get_player_stats
title: Player profile, Rust stats and achievements
